project_info.title: Pink and brown highlight chair dance

prompt.main_subject: An adult dancer with long brown curly hair and pink highlights, wearing a white short cropped hoodie, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots, seated on a glossy black vintage chair while performing a confident chair-dance routine.
prompt.composition_elements: The dancer and glossy black vintage chair anchor a reflective stage floor. A wall of colored circular lights changes with the rhythm, creating a modern pop stage composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hair lighting, face fill light, and soft side light shape the dancer with contrast and dappled shadows. Keep the image layered, polished, trendy, and stage-focused.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Smooth 10-second pacing as stated in the source.
technical_specs.camera: Cinematic camera movement and cutting are requested without a specified path.
technical_specs.audio: Full electronic synthesized music with heavy drum beats; no dialogue or subtitles.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a smooth 10-second vertical 9:16 video with extreme high definition, cinematic camera sense, cinematic image quality, and master-level camera movement and cutting. An adult dancer with long brown curly hair and pink highlights wears a white short cropped hoodie, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots. She sits on a glossy black vintage chair and confidently performs a chair-dance routine. The background is a stage wall made of colored circular lights that change with the rhythm, and the ground is a reflective stage floor. The overall style is trendy and stage-focused, full of modern pop music energy. Use a delicate natural expression, hair lighting, face fill light, soft side light, light and shadow contrast, dappled light and shadow, rich picture layers, clear facial detail, long eyelashes, defined makeup, and a natural cool-white skin tone. Use full electronic synthesized music with heavy drum beats, no dialogue, and no subtitles. Keep normal human body structure, smooth stable movement, and no flickering.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, stiff movements, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
